sloka: स शक्तिमान् शक्तिसमाहतः सन् मुहुः प्रजज्वाल रघुप्रवीरः ।तं विह्वलन्तं सहसा ऽभ्युपेत्य जग्राह राजा तरसा भुजाभ्याम् ।। ६.५९.११० ।।।।
transliteration: sa śaktimān śaktisamāhataḥ san muhuḥ prajajvāla raghupravīraḥ ।taṁ vihvalantaṁ sahasā 'bhyupetya jagrāha rājā tarasā bhujābhyām ।। 6.59.110 ।।।।

translations.english: Lakshmana, the brother of Bharata struck the fierce weapon coming towards him like flames of fire fuelled by ghee, even then it struck him on his broad chest.
